claims.statement: Time-dependent positive lift with PE=I,PK=0 yields the exact residual and coarse discrepancy identities.
The nominal contraction improves only the initial-residual entry; T=exp(BH)-(1-rho)e1e1^T is nonnegative and gives the endpoint comparison.
For the declared state-matched HD exchange network, equal H/D/charge invariants imply e=s*eta and the scalar coarse error has nonnegative physical feedback damping.
Whole-block positive boxes and declared branch/destruction inputs give explicit safe a,b,c,d,g coefficients.
Applying the length-H contraction to all in-block forcing fails for a positive two-state system with late formation.
An augmented positive-series upper bound encloses both matrix exponential and convolution without inverting B.
